title: The normalized scalar/pullback comparison respects geometric composition
statement: Let A,B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B, and X --j→ Z --r→ Y arbitrary scheme morphisms. Use arbitrary normalized models m of [def-sp-open-scalar-tensor-data]. Write S_T for scalar extension, P_R for geometric inverse image, λ for its scalar comparison, and κ_R:P_R(j)P_R(r)≅P_R(j;r) for the canonical compositor [pur713-def-pullback-comparison]. For every L in D(Y,A), S_X(κ_A(L));λ_(j;r)^(-1)(L) = λ_j^(-1)(P_A(r)L);P_B(j)(λ_r^(-1)(L));κ_B(S_Y L). No openness, boundedness, or coefficient flatness is required.

proof.text: The section-normalized ordinary direct-image compositor is unique. The canonical ordinary inverse-image compositor and StrictTower.moduleGComp are its adjunction conjugates under the same unit-normalized adjunctions, hence agree.

Apply the composition formula for adjunction mates under the three scalar adjunctions and cancel the target compositor inverse. This gives the published scalar/pullback composition formula. Expand lambda, cancel the intermediate scalarIso changes, and move the outer changes through κ by naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarPullbackCompositionCoherence (m : Models.{u})
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) (r : Z ⟶ Y)
    (L : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y A) :
    (scalar m φ X).map ((proEtaleConstantRingPullbackComposition j r A).hom.app L) ≫
        (lambda m φ (j ≫ r)).inv.app L =
      (lambda m φ j).inv.app ((constantPullback (A := A) r).obj L) ≫
        (constantPullback (A := B) j).map ((lambda m φ r).inv.app L) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingPullbackComposition j r B).hom.app ((scalar m φ Y).obj L)
